messages.subject: Error on latest commit
parts:
Hi Mike,

I I've found a bug with the second to last commit on Github: 95bf16ba7f736ee81d4305b4795c4c1b1d8b58e7 (carried on to the latest commit which I just cloned).

I think there's an argument messing called 'foodlim'. I cloned the repo yesterday to check out the new argument name changes (e.g. amass to Ww_g) but found that when running NicheMapR::ectotherm() I'd get an error, citing foodlim being missing.

I stuck foodlim=1 as an argument and re-ran the model and it worked as expected. However, I'm not sure whether a value of 1 is correct or not.

Cheers,
Simon

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Error on latest commit
parts:
Good spotting Simon,

I'm in the middle of work on the ectotherm model right now so best not to use the version on GitHub.

I'm aiming to put a new release together next week with updated code and binaries. I'm gearing up for NicheMapR v.2 later in the year, which will have a formal release of the ectotherm model, with a number of things ironed out including some of the symbols and also the DEB holometabolous insect life cycle model (which is where that foodlim parameter comes in - I've included it to allow different stages to be limited by soil moisture-derived estimates of food availability).

All the best,
Mike
